slotNotes.signup-njfa: Let's not recommend any NJFA tournaments for the time being.  They are very unreliable organizers.  Many of their signups are bogus.  They sign up their own members to get others to join but when you show up the turnout is highly variable.  Many times our fencers have shown up with only 1-2 competitors.  They want you to stay for their class afterwards.
